witness.branch: All three obligations during unattended standing on a grade
witness.quote: A vehicle shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.
witness.reason: The heldout sloped-road parking cell directly supports grade, curb and subsequent unattended-standing evidence.

Establish an included vehicle with an actual engine, brake and steerable front wheels.
